digest.component_or_area: configuration ownership enforcement and legacy facade removal (RP-04)
propositions: An AST-based deterministic ownership gate must be implemented to reject direct or aliased environment access, backend property reloads, and configurable adapter defaults outside approved composition seams.

Every config and credential name must have exactly one declared owner in an authoritative registry; test-only controls and protocol constants require exact path+symbol+rationale entries without path globs.
The ownership gate must be wired into make lint and CI workflows, with parity tests ensuring both the ownership gate and field-consumption gate (check_config_reads.py) are always executed.

Generated documentation (config.md, security.md) must be derived from and kept in sync with schema and ownership registries, covering lifecycle, precedence, restart behavior, observability, and subprocess constraints.

Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job SSM paths, and exceptions must be removed only after focused suites and bounded live canaries pass; rollback must retain the S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor.
All S1-S6 behavioral test suites must continue to pass after legacy removal; the structural ownership gate is a change detector, not a correctness oracle.
